targetTexts.1: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
targetTexts.2: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
targetTexts.3: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
targetTexts.4: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
targetTexts.5: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
targetTexts.6: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
targetTexts.7: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
targetTexts.8: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
targetTexts.9: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
targetTexts.10: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
targetTexts.11: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
targetTexts.12: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
targetTexts.13: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
targetTexts.14: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
targetTexts.15: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
targetTexts.16: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
targetTexts.17: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
targetTexts.18: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
targetTexts.19: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
targetTexts.20: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
targetTexts.21: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
targetTexts.22: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
targetTexts.23: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
targetTexts.24: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
targetTexts.25: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
targetTexts.26: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
